definitions.explanation: To rise to an upright position on one's feet. The opposite of {座|すわ}る (to sit).

definitions.gloss: to be built, to be located
definitions.explanation: Can describe buildings or structures being in a location.

examples.japanese: ずっと{立|た}っています。
examples.english: I've been standing the whole time.

examples.japanese: あそこに{建物|たてもの}が{立|た}っています。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xが{立|た}つ (X stands).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {立|た}っている = 'is standing' (in standing position).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{立|た}ってください (please stand up)
・ずっと{立|た}っている (been standing the whole time)
・{列|れつ}に{立|た}つ (stand in line)
・{役|やく}に{立|た}つ (be useful)

Opposite: {座|すわ}る (to sit). Related: {立|た}ち{上|あ}がる (stand up), {立|た}ち{止|ど}まる (stop). Different from {経|た}つ (time passes).
